part.text: All 44 test suites pass (685 tests). Let me verify the final diff:

Fixed. The bug was in `hashCollection` (src/CollectionImpl.js:746): it used the return value of `__iterate` as the collection size when computing the murmur hash. For `OrderedSet`/`OrderedMap`, removal leaves `undefined` tombstone entries in the internal `_list`, so `__iterate` returns a count inflated by those tombstones even though only real entries are hashed. Two `OrderedSet`s containing the same elements in the same order could therefore get different `hashCode()` values (and `equals` fast-paths on cached `__hash`, causing false inequality in hashed collections).

The fix uses `collection.size` (the authoritative entry count) for `murmurHashOfSize`, matching how `__iterate` only visits real entries. The previously failing test (`hashCode should return the same value if the values are the same`) now passes, and the full suite (44 suites, 685 tests) passes.
